title: Google\Cloud\PubSub\V1\PubsubMessage
name: PubsubMessage
description: A message that is published by publishers and consumed by subscribers. The message must contain either a non-empty data field or at least one attribute.

params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.data
params.description: The message data field. If this field is empty, the message must contain at least one attribute.

params.name: data.attributes
params.description: Attributes for this message. If this field is empty, the message must contain non-empty data. This can be used to filter messages on the subscription.

params.name: data.message_id
params.description: ID of this message, assigned by the server when the message is published. Guaranteed to be unique within the topic. This value may be read by a subscriber that receives a PubsubMessage via a Pull call or a push delivery. It must not be populated by the publisher in a Publish call.

params.name: data.publish_time
params.description: The time at which the message was published, populated by the server when it receives the Publish call. It must not be populated by the publisher in a Publish call.

params.name: data.ordering_key
params.description: If non-empty, identifies related messages for which publish order should be respected. If a Subscription has enable_message_ordering set to true, messages published with the same non-empty ordering_key value will be delivered to subscribers in the order in which they are received by the Pub/Sub system. All PubsubMessages published in a given PublishRequest must specify the same ordering_key value.
